## Outgoing

- loads `bc-durable-subagents` — required, when every launch and every recovery of a prior run.
  Run folder, manifest, async fan-out, artifacts with Commit/Branch records, durability packet bullets and recover-before-relaunch have one home in bc-durable-subagents; bc-swarm keeps only the delegate-by-default posture.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

- depends on `bc-tdd`'s contract — required, when worker and review packets for code changes, and parent commits.
  Packets may not waive a tdd level or the property library without quoting the owner; review packets carry the Test levels block or Test-levels trailers for the reviewer to audit.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#what-bc-swarm-packets-add)

- loads `bc-tdd` — required, when worker and review packets for code changes.
  Packets carry tdd's Test levels rules; the body names the skill instead of linking into its folder.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#what-bc-swarm-packets-add)
